ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-01-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288

Petitioner JERRY VINCENT WHITE was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file. Also appearing is the mother of the minor children, SHARI LYNN WHITE, placed under oath and examined. The following minor children are also on calendar for name change: MAXIMO VINCENT WHITE and JACQUELINE BELLA WHITE.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to:
JERRY VINCENT WHITE to JERRY VINCENT TOCCHINI (FATHER)
MAXIMO VINCENT WHITE to MAXIMO VINCENT TOCCHINI (MINOR)
JACQUELINE BELLA WHITE to JACQUELINE BELLA TOCCHINI (MINOR)
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
